q: How much does an extension or loft conversion cost?
a: Most extensions come in between £66,000 and £144,000, and most loft conversions between £54,000 and £90,000, including VAT. Where you land depends on size, whether it's one storey or two, and the specification. Every quotation is for the full job to a plastered finish — kitchens included where you'd like us to supply them; decoration and any bespoke kitchen are the only things typically left to you. You'll see the full itemised breakdown before you commit, and unless you change the scope, that figure holds.

q: Is the price you quote really the price I pay?
a: Yes. Every quotation is itemised line by line before work starts, so you can see where the money goes. We take a 10% deposit at the start and the rest in stages as the work progresses — you're never paying far ahead of what's actually been built. Unless you change the scope, the quoted figure is the figure you pay.

q: How long will my build take?
a: It depends on the job, and we give you a realistic schedule with a start and finish date before we begin. Because Jason runs a small number of projects at once, yours gets worked on continuously rather than left while crews are pulled elsewhere — which is why our builds tend to finish quicker than clients expect.

q: Who will actually run my project?
a: Jason Berry, personally. He visits your home, prices the job, manages the build day to day and hands it over. With 15 to 20 projects a year, he's genuinely on each one — you're not passed to a foreman once the deposit's paid.
